metadata.title: Focused prior-art screen for selected semantic candidates
metadata.method: Focused web and scholarly-source screen. This is not a systematic review.
metadata.epistemic_note: A focused search can locate prior art; failure to locate a direct comparison does not establish novelty.

entries.direct_comparison: No focused pairwise comparison was located. A broad 2026 review places several Pacific and Native Hawaiian models in one comparative synthesis while preserving culture-specific meanings.
entries.assessment: The thematic resemblance is real but the Native Hawaiian endpoint appears to combine distinct concepts and named models. Split it into source-specific records before evaluating a relationship.
entries.caution: Do not infer equivalence, lineage, or cultural interchangeability from shared relational-health vocabulary.

entries.direct_comparison: No direct comparison of the two named paradigm families was located in the focused screen.
entries.assessment: Both use decisions under uncertainty, but they target different constructs. The useful lead is a rival-explanation or within-subject test: affective state may alter apparent uncertainty monitoring without demonstrating metarepresentation.
entries.caution: Do not treat judgment bias and metacognitive monitoring as measures of the same state.

entries.direct_comparison: Direct prior art was located: Gross's emotion-regulation theory has been explicitly formalized as a computational model for artificial and virtual agents within affective computing.
entries.assessment: This is an established implementation bridge, not a new connection discovered by the embedding run.
entries.caution: Affective computing is a broad engineering field; Gross's process model is one psychological account and the two are not equivalent.

entries.direct_comparison: No dedicated head-to-head validation was located. Existing reviews place subjective visibility scales and no-report methods within the same measurement problem.
entries.assessment: The pair is a useful methodological contrast and calibration dependency: one collects graded report, while the other reduces overt reporting but normally depends on report-calibrated indicators.
entries.caution: Do not infer that a no-report condition removes every post-perceptual process or that PAS directly validates every no-report proxy.

entries.direct_comparison: Ruffini explicitly describes predictive processing as closely related to the Kolmogorov account while distinguishing algorithmic description length from Bayesian inference. No formal equivalence with active-inference policy selection was located.
entries.assessment: This is established conceptual prior art with an unresolved formal question, not evidence that Kolmogorov complexity and variational complexity are identical.
entries.caution: The models use different mathematical notions of complexity. A relation stronger than conceptual comparison requires a formal derivation and divergent predictions.

entries.direct_comparison: The Pure-Awareness Entropy Model is explicitly developed within an active-inference and predictive-processing lineage. A 2021 precursor had already applied predictive processing to deconstructive meditation and pure or nondual awareness. The focused screen did not locate independent head-to-head validation of the 2026 model's state-specific entropy claims against predictive-processing accounts generally.
entries.assessment: This is established conceptual lineage rather than a new embedding-discovered connection. The reviewable question is whether the model adds discriminating state-level predictions beyond the predictive-processing framework it inherits.
entries.caution: A predictive-processing foundation does not by itself validate the proposed entropy trajectory, minimal-phenomenology interpretation, or neural implementation.

entries.direct_comparison: A separate 2026 peer-reviewed paper directly applies the algorithmic-agent and algorithmic-information program to pure awareness and minimal experience, and proposes predictive-processing whole-brain models. No formal head-to-head comparison with the Pure-Awareness Entropy Model was located.
entries.assessment: Direct prior art therefore exists for the algorithmic-information-to-pure-awareness bridge; the embedding did not discover that connection. A still-useful discriminating test is to analyze the same simulated or empirical time series with dynamical-entropy and algorithmic-compressibility proxies, asking whether increased variability diverges from structured, recursively generated complexity.
entries.caution: Shannon or dynamical entropy is not Kolmogorov complexity; apparent entropy can coexist with algorithmic compressibility. Reduced phenomenal content also does not entail lower or higher neural entropy without an explicit measurement model.

entries.direct_comparison: No direct comparison between the Universality Criterion and the Multiple Generator Hypothesis was located in the focused primary-source screen.
entries.assessment: The productive question is whether universality can operate as a meta-level requirement that admits multiple independently sufficient generators, or whether a universal theory must identify one generator-independent principle that constrains them all.
entries.caution: Universality across possible systems and plurality of sufficient generators within human brains are different analytical axes. Their coexistence, tension, or incompatibility requires explicit formal criteria rather than semantic proximity.

entries.direct_comparison: No direct comparison between Attentional Modulation of Energy Theory and AIR theory was located in the focused screen. Both assign a constitutive role to attention, but the named mechanisms and explanatory targets differ.
entries.assessment: The pair is best treated as a discriminating contrast: Attentional Modulation of Energy Theory proposes that attention detects self-state and modulates an organ-of-attention energy level, whereas AIR makes conscious perceptual content depend on attention making intermediate-level representations available for working memory.
entries.caution: Shared attention vocabulary does not establish a shared mechanism. The energy-modulation proposal remains a hypothesis-level account, while AIR's representational level and availability claims require their own tests.

entries.direct_comparison: No direct comparison between Neurophenomenal Structuralism and the Process Meta-Representation and Qualia-Space Hypothesis was located in the focused primary-source screen.
entries.assessment: A defensible bridge would require mapping the process model's relational qualia-space geometry onto independently measured phenomenal similarity structure and neural relational structure. That would turn a vocabulary-level resemblance into a falsifiable structural comparison.
entries.caution: The process-meta-representation paper is a proof of concept that excludes activation dynamics, while Neurophenomenal Structuralism addresses content-specific Q-N structure rather than a complete account of generic consciousness. Current semantic proximity is not evidence of structural isomorphism.

entries.direct_comparison: Direct prior art was located: the primary Multiple Generator Hypothesis paper explicitly discusses Joint Determinant Theory, and the 2025 methodology paper places both among distinct pluralist alternatives to exclusive winner-take-all theory comparison.
entries.assessment: This is an established methodological comparison, not a newly discovered connection. Joint Determinant Theory proposes that multiple mechanisms or aspects jointly determine conscious experience; the Multiple Generator Hypothesis allows more than one independently sufficient principle or neural generator.
entries.caution: Joint contribution and independent sufficiency are not equivalent pluralisms. Their empirical predictions and units of analysis must remain separate.

entries.direct_comparison: Direct literature explicitly situates the Double Empathy Problem within neurodiversity-compatible and neurodiversity-affirming scholarship, while the 2026 author-led clarification defines it as a sociological and relational framework rather than a social-cognitive theory of autism.
entries.assessment: The compatibility is established prior art, not a new semantic discovery. Double Empathy supplies a relational account of some cross-disposition interaction failures; the Neurodiversity Paradigm is a broader descriptive, normative, political, and research framework.
entries.caution: The records are not interchangeable. Alignment with neurodiversity does not establish universal symmetry, erase individual impairment or support needs, or turn the broader paradigm into an empirical mechanism of consciousness or social cognition.

entries.direct_comparison: The 2026 Algorithmic Agent Model of Pure Awareness explicitly develops the earlier algorithmic-information account of structured experience, includes Ruffini as a coauthor, and applies that framework to minimal and nondual experience.
entries.assessment: This is direct intellectual and model lineage, not a novel relationship generated by semantic analysis. The later record should remain separate because it adds a state-specific self-model-of-modeling hypothesis and proposed contemplative and predictive-processing tests.
entries.caution: The lineage source is not independent confirmation. Application of the algorithmic-agent framework to pure awareness does not validate the general consciousness theory or show that its mechanism is necessary or sufficient.

entries.direct_comparison: Both peer-reviewed 2026 models target pure awareness and minimal phenomenal experience, but no formal head-to-head comparison or cross-validation between them was located in the focused screen.
entries.assessment: This is a high-value discriminating comparison, not evidence of convergence. The entropy model emphasizes hierarchical precision redistribution, epistemic depth, and synthetic EEG entropy; the algorithmic-agent model emphasizes compressive world models and an agent's model of its own modeling process. Applying both measurement and simulation recipes to the same prospectively identified episodes could expose divergent predictions.
entries.caution: Shared predictive-processing vocabulary and a shared explanandum do not make the mechanisms equivalent. Shannon or dynamical entropy, algorithmic complexity, compressibility, epistemic depth, and metamodeling must be operationalized separately.
